author: ojiudezue
title: Overnight feed timestamps were estimated ahead of the clock and had to be rewritten
summary: Overnight feed timestamps were estimated ahead of the clock and had to be rewritten
context: During the 11-17 overnight pass I stamped cards and feed entries 02:12-02:55 from a felt sense of elapsed work; `date` read 02:07. The skill already forbids this (coined 10-14 after the same mistake).
why: Invented times corrupt the 24 h counter, staleness order and the anti-starvation tie-break, and read as evidence. Corrected every stamp from that run in one commit (c9e5fdd8c) and switched the later edits to read `date` inside the edit script.
implications: Every timestamp written by an edit script should come from the clock inside that script, not from a literal typed by the agent.
revisit_trigger: If a feed entry is ever dated after the commit that wrote it, the rule failed again; add a renderer check (at > commit time) instead of another rule.
